about: Trigger-accuracy corpus for the fabflows-tickets plugin's three skills. Same shape as plugins/ciso/evals/trigger-corpus.json and run by the same manual procedure (plugins/ciso/evals/RUNBOOK.md). `setup` should load when choosing where specs live; `ticket` when linking, updating or closing a tracker ticket; `trace` when tracing merged changes to tickets, specs and approvals for an audit. The negatives share the trigger vocabulary (ticket, Jira, Linear, issue, trace, audit, set up) with an intent no fabflows-tickets skill serves.
